summary: Pre-market, 2026-10-08: the composite stands at 49.49, still caution with the goldilocks regime intact and model confidence at 0.9067. The overnight story is an energy-driven inflation scare: WTI is up 5.09% to 92.771, Brent is up 5.20% to 105.407, KOSPI fell 2.6% and the Dow futures contract is down 1.02%. Mainland China reopened after the 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 holiday and the storage complex sold off hard, 688825.SH at -7.7934, 603986.SH at -5.51 and 301308.SZ at -4.4149. The last completed US session was split rather than weak: MU at 4.0591 against NVDA -0.7398, AMD -0.5482 and TSLA -0.7539, with memory at -2.4292 and data centers at -2.5693 while semis leaders held 0.7393. Rates eased on a fresh 2026-10-06 vintage, the 10-year at 5.27 from 5.31, the 2-year at 4.79 from 4.84 and the real rate at 2.91 from 2.95, and VIX fell to 15.01 from 15.52.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The macro leg remains the binding constraint at 72.56: the 10-year real rate is at 2.91, the 99.76th percentile, and the 10-year yield is at 5.27, the 99.52nd percentile, even though both eased from 2.95 and 5.31.
Mainland China reopened after the 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 holiday, and the storage and memory complex led the decline: 688825.SH at -7.7934, 603986.SH at -5.51 and 301308.SZ at -4.4149.

Sector dispersion inside the last completed US session was wide: semis leaders at 0.7393 and digital advertising at 0.837, against memory at -2.4292, data centers at -2.5693, quantum computing at -3.0801 and semiconductor equipment at -2.3616.

Cross-asset confirmation still carries the largest single contribution at 7.5 on a reading of 0.75, but the dollar leg behind it has not advanced: it stands at 121.3848 from 121.7882 on a 2026-10-02 vintage.

Policy is priced for a hike again: Fedwatch implies 4.08 against the delivered rate of 3.88, and the 2026-09 minutes together with Governor Waller's remarks point to selective hikes rather than a sustained campaign.

supporting_signals.claim: The A-share reopening decline was broad, not isolated: 10 of the 11 mainland names in the layer fell, with 300223.SZ at -7.2861, 688825.SH at -7.7934 and 300475.SZ at -5.3902, and only 000021.SZ advancing at 0.8833.
US large-cap semis split rather than fell together in the last completed session: MU at 4.0591 and AVGO at 0.1863 against NVDA at -0.7398, AMD at -0.5482 and TSLA at -0.7539.
Crypto de-rated alongside equities: bitcoin at 82697 with a single-day change of -1.23881, ether at 2554.54 and solana at 114.52 with a single-day change of -2.69871.
Equity structure keeps deteriorating: only 0.6 of qualifying names sit above their 200-day average, and the new-highs ratio is 0.0385 against a new-lows ratio of 0.1026.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit did not confirm the risk-off tape: HY OAS tightened to 3.03 from 3.12 and IG OAS to 0.83 from 0.84.
Volatility fell rather than rose: VIX eased to 15.01 from 15.52 on a 2026-10-06 vintage, so the calm reading is a live observation rather than a frozen series.
The rates input lags the fact layer: the 5.27 and 2.91 observations carry a 2026-10-06 vintage, two sessions behind the 2026-10-08 layer.
Liquidity and participation held rather than broke: reverse repo refilled to 2.338 from 0.414 while breadth stayed at 0.6.

what_changed_today: Rates printed a fresh observation on a 2026-10-06 vintage, and it eased: the 10-year to 5.27 from 5.31, the 2-year to 4.79 from 4.84 and the real rate to 2.91 from 2.95.
Volatility kept falling: VIX to 15.01 from 15.52.
Credit tightened a further notch: HY OAS to 3.03 from 3.12 and IG OAS to 0.83 from 0.84.
Mainland China reopened after the 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 holiday and sold off, led by the storage complex: 688825.SH -7.7934, 603986.SH -5.51 and 301308.SZ -4.4149.
The overnight session turned risk-off on an energy shock: WTI up 5.09% to 92.771 and Brent up 5.20% to 105.407, KOSPI down 2.6%, the Dow futures contract down 1.02%.
Policy pricing flipped back to a hike: Fedwatch implies 4.08 against dff 3.88, after the 2026-09 minutes and Governor Waller's remarks.
The composite held at 49.49 with trend_1d at 0.06 and trend_1w at -0.9, and model confidence at 0.9067.
watch_next: Whether the energy shock transmits into the rates complex: the 2026-10-06 vintage still predates the oil move.
Whether the A-share reopening decline extends beyond the storage complex once full session breadth is available, given that 10 of the 11 mainland names in the layer already fell.
Whether the 10-year at 5.27 and the real rate at 2.91 keep easing or re-steepen on the energy shock.
Whether the dollar leg finally advances from its 2026-10-02 vintage at 121.3848.
Whether credit keeps improving: HY OAS at 3.03 and IG OAS at 0.83 remain the cleanest offset to the risk-off tape.
The US high-importance data: CPI on 2026-10-14, then PPI and advance retail sales on 2026-10-15.
The third-quarter earnings season opening on 2026-10-13 with C, GS, JNJ, JPM, UNH and WFC, then TSM on 2026-10-15; PEP has already reported an actual of 2.34 against a forecast of 2.29.
Whether the hawkish repricing holds: Fedwatch at 4.08 against dff 3.88 while the minutes show no appetite for consecutive hikes.

bull_case.title: Bull case: credit and volatility keep offsetting the energy shock
points: Credit is not confirming the risk-off tape: HY OAS at 3.03 from 3.12 and IG OAS at 0.83 from 0.84 are the tightest reads in the layer.
VIX at 15.01 from 15.52 on a fresh 2026-10-06 vintage, so the calm reading is a live observation rather than a frozen series.
The composite is only 49.49 with the goldilocks regime intact and model confidence at 0.9067.
Rates eased rather than re-steepened, the 10-year at 5.27 from 5.31 and the real rate at 2.91 from 2.95.

base_case.title: Base case: a narrow, energy-driven risk-off inside an intact goldilocks regime
points: The composite holds between 45.0 and 55.0 with the macro leg at 72.56 and cross-asset confirmation at 0.75.
The US de-rating stays concentrated: memory at -2.4292 and data centers at -2.5693 against semis leaders at 0.7393.
Credit and volatility keep offsetting the tape, as they did with HY OAS at 3.03 and VIX at 15.01.
Policy stays priced for a hike, Fedwatch at 4.08 against dff 3.88, without forcing a broad repricing.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the energy shock turns a narrow de-rating into a broad one
points: The overnight tape is already broad: WTI up 5.09% and Brent up 5.20%, KOSPI down 2.6% and the Dow futures contract down 1.02%, so a further leg needs no new catalyst.
A-share storage led the reopening lower: 688825.SH at -7.7934, 300223.SZ at -7.2861 and 603986.SH at -5.51.
Breadth is thin: 0.6 above the 200-day average, with a new-highs ratio of 0.0385 against new lows of 0.1026.
The 10-year at 5.27 and the real rate at 2.91 sit at the 99.52nd and 99.76th percentiles, leaving limited valuation cushion.
